title: Upper-level balconies or windows overlook the street and public domain
text: Addressing the street. C3.6.1 For apartments, upper level balconies and/or windows overlook the street and public domain areas, including public open space where applicable.

replaces.note: adds 'including public open space where applicable'
Part B C3.1-C3.3; R10-R25 'major opening faces the street' rule dropped

notes: diverges: no ch3 twin for the street limb. Chapter 3 C3.6.1 (entrance identifiable, major opening to the frontage) has no Chapter 4 Part 1 equivalent; this clause (p37) asks that upper-level balconies and/or windows overlook the street and public domain areas. Tested with building.upper_level_overlook_street, applied only where the building has an upper level (building.storeys >= 2). The public open space limb ('where applicable') is C3.6.1-r1, from ch3 C3.6.2.

verified.note: Wording confirmed (printed with a double full stop). 'Upper level' is read as a building of two or more storeys (interpretation).
